title: Themes in Settings › Appearance
question: How should picking a theme work? (Click themes: the whole page changes live)

variants.label: Theme cards
variants.notes: Cards with a mini preview, grouped Dark and Light. Click one and the whole app switches instantly. 8 themes: OLED (default), Midnight (the old indigo one), Graphite, Fjord, Forest, High contrast, Daylight, Linen.

variants.label: List + preview
variants.notes: A list with colour swatches and a big preview. Nothing changes until you press “Use this theme”. 8 themes: OLED (default), Midnight (the old indigo one), Graphite, Fjord, Forest, High contrast, Daylight, Linen.

variants.label: Cards + create your own
variants.notes: Same cards as A plus a theme editor: pick background, panels, text and the 8 section colours with live preview, export or import as JSON. 8 themes: OLED (default), Midnight (the old indigo one), Graphite, Fjord, Forest, High contrast, Daylight, Linen.
